$comment: EXP-11 fixture (Phase 21, D-21-15): §2 says X causes Y, §3 says there is no relationship between X and Y. The citations name recorded works (tests/helpers/gate-paper.ts RECORDED_BIB) so Pass 1 verifies them offline; the claims are invented for the fixture.

sections.title: Learning Representations
sections.draft:
Neural networks with many layers learn representations of raw data at several levels of abstraction [@lecun2015].

These layered models now set the pace for speech and image recognition across the field [@lecun2015].
claims: Deep networks learn layered representations of raw data.

sections.title: Screen Time and Sleep
sections.draft:
Heavy screen time causes sleep loss in adolescents across the schools we surveyed [@aspelmeyer2009].

The effect was largest for students who used phones after midnight on school nights [@aspelmeyer2009].
claims: Heavy screen time causes sleep loss in adolescents.

sections.title: A Second Look
sections.draft:
There is no relationship between screen time and sleep loss in adolescents at these schools [@zhu2020].

A longer study would be needed to settle how teenagers sleep during exam periods [@zhu2020].
claims: There is no relationship between screen time and sleep loss in adolescents.
